document_title: KAP Detayli Sorgulama (disclosure query surface) - filter semantics and result cap
company_name: NA
membership_consequence: NA
notes: First-party disclosure archive. Query is a POST to /tr/api/disclosure/members/byCriteria with fields fromDate, toDate, memberType, mkkMemberOidList, inactiveMkkMemberOidList, disclosureClass, subjectList, mainSector, sector, marketOid, index, year, term, period. Date filter is inclusive YYYY-MM-DD. disclosureClass takes ALL/FR/ODA/DUY/DG. subjectList takes stable subjectOid values. The page states its own result cap verbatim: "Arama sonuclari 2000 bildirim ile sinirlidir" (results limited to 2000 notifications). Every 2017-2020 query used here returned far fewer than 2000 rows, so the cap did not bind. Individual disclosures are addressable by stable numeric disclosureIndex at /tr/Bildirim/<id>, as rendered PDF at /tr/api/BildirimPdf/<id>, and as structured JSON at /tr/api/notification/attachment-detail/<id>.

document_title: Fail-closed handling of ambiguous archive results (query-client behaviour finding)
company_name: NA
membership_consequence: NA
notes: CRITICAL METHOD FINDING. Under throttling the endpoint answers with HTTP 200-class handling but an EMPTY body, which a naive client parses as zero results. An empty body is therefore NOT evidence of zero disclosures. Every count reported in this audit was produced by a client that accepts a result only when the body parses as a JSON array, and retries up to six times with increasing backoff otherwise; a query that never returns an array is recorded SEARCH_INCOMPLETE and is never converted into a negative.

document_title: BIST Pay Endeksleri Temel Kurallari - Kasim 2015
company_name: NA
membership_consequence: NA
effective_date_rule: See notes - art. 7 chapeau and per-article timing rules
notes: Announced by node 11703 (27.11.2015). In force for the whole of 2017 and until 08.06.2018. Art. 6(d): reserves BIST 30=2, BIST 50=3, BIST 100=5, Temettu 25=5. Art. 7 chapeau: a disclosure must be on KAP by 16:30 on the business day before the event date (12:00 on a half day), otherwise the change takes effect on the SECOND business day after KAP publication. Art. 7.1 permanent closure / closure >5 consecutive business days / transfer to Yakin Izleme Pazari removes the share from every index it is in, effective on the day of the closure or transfer, and BIST 30/50/100/Temettu 25 vacancies are filled from reserves. Art. 7.2 transfer to any other market removes from the old market index and adds to the new one, with BIST 30/50/100 vacancies filled from reserves. Art. 7.3 A/B/C/D list transitions, same day, reserves fill. Art. 7.4 a share removed under 7.1-7.3 is not re-admitted before the period ends. Art. 7.6 IPO fast entry on the 5th trading day. Art. 8.3: any matter NOT regulated by these Rules is determined and announced by the Borsa Istanbul General Directorate.
